sections.title: Insulin
notes: Apidra® in insulin pump will not be substituted.
Insulin U-500 conversion is not an automatic therapeutic substitution and requires conversation with MP.

rows.ordered:
Insulin Glulisine (Apidra®)
*Apidra® in insulin pump will not be substituted.

rows.substitute:
Insulin u-100
Patients using insulin regular U-500 who are admitted should
be converted to insulin u-100 based on the below calculation
after conversation with MP:
1. Calculate total daily dose (TDD) of u-500 (in units of insulin
given)
2. Reduce TDD of u-500 by 20% to obtain new u-100
requirements
3. If patient is PO--> take 50% of new u-100 TDD as insulin
glargine (may split dose into BID dosing if individual doses
exceed 50 units) and take remainder 50% and split evenly into
aspart TID dosing. Add sliding scale insulin to this regimen.
4. If patient is NPO--> take 50% of new u-100 TDD as insulin
glargine (may split dose into BID dosing if individual doses
exceed 50 units) and add sliding scale therapy to regimen.
